title: The Shadow That Quit
narration: At two thirteen in the morning, Boro's shadow walked out of his body. For years, the little street magician had taken the applause. His shadow had done all the work. Tonight, it had enough. It stepped into the spotlight and performed tricks Boro could only dream of. The crowd went wild. Boro tried to steal the show, tripped over his own coat, and landed at his shadow's feet. The shadow pointed to a broom. You're the assistant now. Boro finally got a standing ovation. Unfortunately, it was for the shadow.
